import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int N, LIMIT;
    static List<String> G1, G2;
    static int[][] D1 = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] D2 = new int[30][30];
    static final int[] DX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] DY = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, flow;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> E = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[2000];
    static int[] lvl = new int[2000];
    static int[] pr = new int[2000];

    static boolean inRange(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j) D1[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        D1[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + DX[k], ny = y + DY[k];
                if (inRange(nx, ny) && D1[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && G2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    D1[nx][ny] = D1[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j) D2[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        D2[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (D2[x][y] >= D1[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + DX[k], ny = y + DY[k];
                if (inRange(nx, ny) && D2[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && G1.get(nx).charAt(ny) != 'Y' && D2[x][y] + 1 <= D1[nx][ny]) {
                    D2[nx][ny] = D2[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        lvl[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && lvl[N * N * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                Edge e = E.get(id);
                if (lvl[e.dst] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    lvl[e.dst] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.dst);
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[N * N * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (f == 0 || u == N * N * 2 + 1) return f;
        for (int i = pr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            pr[u] = i;
            int id = adj[u].get(i);
            Edge e = E.get(id);
            if (lvl[e.dst] != lvl[u] + 1) continue;
            int sent = dfs(e.dst, Math.min(f, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (sent != 0) {
                e.flow += sent;
                E.get(id ^ 1).flow -= sent;
                return sent;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int flow() {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(pr, 0);
            int sent;
            while ((sent = dfs(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) != 0) {
                result += sent;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        LIMIT = sc.nextInt();
        G1 = new ArrayList<>();
        G2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) G1.add(sc.next());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) G2.add(sc.next());

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (G2.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    StringBuilder sb1 = new StringBuilder(G1.get(i));
                    StringBuilder sb2 = new StringBuilder(G2.get(i));
                    sb1.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    sb2.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    G1.set(i, sb1.toString());
                    G2.set(i, sb2.toString());
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfs1(zx, zy);

        int V = 2 * N * N + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        E.clear();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (G1.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int u = i * N + j + 1;
                int v = N * N + u;
                int c1 = G1.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                int c2 = G2.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';

                E.add(new Edge(0, u, c1));
                adj[0].add(E.size() - 1);
                E.add(new Edge(u, 0, 0));
                adj[u].add(E.size() - 1);
                E.add(new Edge(v, V - 1, c2));
                adj[v].add(E.size() - 1);
                E.add(new Edge(V - 1, v, 0));
                adj[V - 1].add(E.size() - 1);

                bfs2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < N; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < N; ++y) {
                        if (G2.get(x).charAt(y) == 'Y' || D2[x][y] > LIMIT) continue;
                        int w = N * N + x * N + y + 1;
                        E.add(new Edge(u, w, c1));
                        adj[u].add(E.size() - 1);
                        E.add(new Edge(w, u, 0));
                        adj[w].add(E.size() - 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow());
    }
}
